title: Lost Cat
description: A worried townsperson has lost their cat. Defeat a Cat and return here for a reward.

title: Nasty Thieves
description: A local merchant has reported thieves stealing from their shop. Defeat them and return here for a reward.

title: Fast Travel System
description: Use the Fast Travel System to quickly move to a different location, next one is for free!

title: Spooky Area
description: A local villager has reported a spooky area in the dungeon. Reach depth 15 and return here for a reward.

title: Charity
description: A homeless villager is looking for scraps of gold, spend 55 gold to give it to the villager... Sharing is caring!

title: Pest Control
description: A local farmer has reported a pest infestation. Defeat 5 Plague Rats and return here for a reward.

title: Test Of Faith
description: A local priest has asked you to test your faith. Pray at 3 sculptures and return here for a reward.

title: Rescue Mission
description: A mother has reported her child missing, locals say the seen footsteps leading to the dungeon. Reach depth 5 and return here for a reward.
